user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene of a sea kayak on roof racks. A sea kayak as the hero object resting on a pair of roof-rack cradle bars: a long slender pointed hull with an open cockpit opening, deck rigging lines, and the two support cradles it sits in. Sleek smooth hull. Make it procedural from three.js geometry with realistic proportions, materials and lighting, and orbit controls.
